## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Index files into one filing-index table
      Objective: Build one filing-index table from the real SEC quarterly and daily master index files.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: the filing-index table, readable by later stages; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: One table built from the real quarterly indexes of a chosen range and the real daily indexes after it, with no filing listed twice where quarterly and daily files overlap, and row counts per quarter reported. The findings file records the measured cost of the real run: files and bytes fetched, rows, wall-clock time and the observed request rate.
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability: Stage 4; point-in-time awareness: Stage 5; full validation suite: Stage 6; scheduling and deployment: Stage 7
